titleTr: Bir vekil öğretmen günü: hikâye anlatma zamanları

grammar.topic: Narrative tenses: past simple, past continuous, past perfect
explainTr: Bir hikâye anlatırken üç zaman birlikte çalışır. Past simple olayları sırayla anlatır (She opened the door.), past continuous arka plandaki devam eden eylemi gösterir (The students were talking.), past perfect ise hikâyedeki başka bir andan önce olmuş şeyi anlatır (She had read the plan.).

Past continuous çoğu zaman bir olayın 'sırasında' kullanılır: While I was working, the phone rang. Uzun süren eylem continuous, araya giren kısa olay past simple olur. Past perfect'in kalıbı had + V3'tür ve before, by the time, after gibi kelimelerle çok gelir.
Eski alışkanlıklar için used to ve would da hikâyeye girer: I used to walk to school. 'Would' yalnız tekrarlanan eylemler için olur, durum fiilleriyle (live, have) 'used to' kullanılır.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Geldiğimde ders başlamıştı' ile 'Geldiğimde ders başlıyordu' farkını ek belirler (-mıştı / -ıyordu). İngilizcede bu fark ayrı yapılardır: the class had started / the class was starting.
table: She opened the door and sat down.
I used to walk to school.

exercises.q: By the time Hafsa arrived at school, the bell ___.
exercises.whyTr: Varıştan önce tamamlanan eylem için past perfect gerekir.

exercises.q: While Hafsa ___ the roll, a boy walked in late.
exercises.whyTr: Devam eden eylem (while) past continuous olur; araya giren olay past simple.

exercises.answer: She had printed the sub plan before the bell rang
exercises.whyTr: Önce olan eylem had + V3 ile, sonraki olay past simple ile gelir.

exercises.q: First she opened the door. Then she ___ the lights on.
exercises.whyTr: Sırayla anlatılan olaylar past simple ile verilir.

exercises.q: The students ___ loudly when the principal walked in, and they stopped at once.
exercises.whyTr: Arka planda devam eden eylem past continuous olur.

exercises.q: Hafsa ___ at three different schools before she got this job.
exercises.whyTr: 'Before she got' ifadesinden önceki deneyim past perfect ile anlatılır.

exercises.q: She ___ already left when the teacher arrived.
exercises.whyTr: Öğretmenin gelişinden önce olmuş: had left.

exercises.answer: While the students were working, Hafsa walked around the room
exercises.whyTr: While + past continuous, ardından past simple gelir.

exercises.q: Hafsa ___ in the US since 2023, so she knows the area well.
exercises.whyTr: Since ile başlayıp hâlâ süren durum present perfect olur.

exercises.q: The sub plan ___ on the desk this morning by the teacher.
exercises.whyTr: Eylemi yapan 'by' ile geliyor, cümle edilgen: was + V3.

exercises.q: ___ she was nervous, Hafsa smiled and greeted every student.
exercises.whyTr: Zıtlık için although kullanılır: sinirliydi ama gülümsedi.

exercises.q: I ___ walk to school every day when I was a child.
exercises.whyTr: Geçmiş alışkanlık için used to kullanılır.

reading.title: Hafsa's first day as a substitute
reading.text:
Hafsa had been dreaming about this day for months. At 6:30 a.m. she was already standing in her kitchen, drinking tea and checking her email for the tenth time. Mr. Brown, the school secretary, had sent her the sub plan the night before. It said that she would teach fourth-grade math and reading in Room 14.

When Hafsa arrived at Lincoln Elementary, the hallway was still quiet. Mr. Brown handed her a lanyard and a key. "Ms. Carter is out sick today," he explained, "so the class is yours. The students are friendly, but they sometimes get excited." Hafsa nodded and walked to Room 14. She turned on the lights, wrote her name on the whiteboard, and put the attendance sheet on the desk.

At eight o'clock the children came in. While Hafsa was taking attendance, a boy named Leo raised his hand. "Ms. Carter always lets us start with a game," he said. Hafsa smiled. She had read about this in the sub plan, so she was ready. "Today we will start with a math puzzle," she answered. The class cheered.

The morning went better than she had expected. Then, just before lunch, the fire alarm rang. Hafsa's heart was pounding, but she remembered what she had learned in training. She counted the students, took the attendance sheet, and led everyone outside. Twenty-three children stood in a straight line, and nobody was missing. It was only a drill, but Mr. Brown told her later that she had handled it like a professional.

In the afternoon, the students were writing short stories when a girl started to cry. She had lost her favorite pencil case. Hafsa knelt next to her and said quietly, "Let's look for it together." They found it under a chair. The girl hugged her, and Hafsa felt something she had not felt for a long time: she was proud of herself.

That evening, she called her son Emre. "How was it?" he asked. "Tiring," she said, "but wonderful. I think I have finally found my place."

writing.promptTr: Yoğun bir okul ya da iş gününü anlat. Neler önceden olmuştu, o sırada neler oluyordu, sonra ne oldu? Üç zamanı birlikte kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a paragraph (120-180 words) about a busy day at school or work. Say what had happened before, what was happening, and what happened next.
frames: At the end of the day, ...
writing.model: Last Monday was a very busy day. When I arrived at the school, the principal had already left for a meeting, and the office was empty. I was looking for the sub plan when the phone rang. It was Mr. Brown, and he asked me to cover a second classroom. I had never taught fifth grade before, so I felt nervous. While the students were reading quietly, I walked around the room and helped a girl who was struggling with a difficult word. After lunch, we had a short math quiz. Nobody finished early, because I had given them a hard puzzle! At the end of the day, I was exhausted, but I was also proud. I had survived my first double day, and I had learned a lot about managing a classroom. Next time, I will prepare even more carefully.
checklistTr: Past perfect (had + V3) en az iki yerde var mı?
'While' ile past continuous ve ardından past simple kullandın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?

examSet.q: Hafsa ___ the report when the power went out.
examSet.whyTr: Araya giren olay sırasında devam eden eylem: past continuous.

examSet.q: By the time the substitute arrived, the students ___ already ___ their seats.
examSet.whyTr: Varıştan önce tamamlanmış: had taken.

examSet.q: I couldn't open the classroom because I ___ my keys.
examSet.whyTr: Olumsuz sonucun nedeni, önceki bir olay: past perfect.

examSet.answer: What were you doing when the fire alarm rang?
examSet.whyTr: Past continuous soru: What + were + özne + V-ing.

examSet.q: Yesterday I met Linda while I ___ to the store.
examSet.whyTr: While ile devam eden eylem: was walking.

examSet.q: Hafsa ___ never taught fourth grade before that day.
examSet.whyTr: 'Before that day' önceki deneyim: had never taught.

examSet.q: Good teachers ___ students when they work hard.
examSet.whyTr: Çok çalışanı övmek: praise.

examSet.q: Which word is closest in meaning to "calm"?
examSet.whyTr: Calm ve peaceful benzer anlamlıdır.
Praise'in zıddı criticize.

examSet.q: A good sub must ___ a noisy class without shouting.
examSet.whyTr: Gürültülü sınıfı idare etmek: handle (manage).

examSet.q: How long ___ you ___ in the US?
examSet.whyTr: Süren durum için present perfect: How long have you lived?

examSet.q: Hafsa smiled ___ she was very nervous.
examSet.whyTr: Zıtlık anlatan bağlaç: although.

examSet.q:
Mia had been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes when she realized it was a holiday. She walked home and made tea.

What had Mia done before she realized it was a holiday?
options: She had waited for the bus.
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'had been waiting for the bus'.

examSet.q:
Mr. Lee was grading papers when the principal knocked. She asked him to cover a class because a teacher had called in sick. He packed his things and ran down the hall.

Why did Mr. Lee cover the class?
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'a teacher had called in sick'.

While I clean the board, the bell rang.
examSet.whyTr: Devam eden eylem past continuous, araya giren olay past simple.

examSet.q: If it rains tomorrow, the field trip ___.
examSet.whyTr: Gelecekteki olası durum: will be + V3.

examSet.q: When I was a child, my grandmother ___ tell us stories every night.
examSet.whyTr: Tekrarlanan geçmiş alışkanlık için would kullanılabilir.

examSet.q: After Hafsa ___ the form, she gave it to Mr. Brown.
examSet.whyTr: Önce biten eylem: had signed.

examSet.q: Which sentence describes a background action in a story?
options: The sun was shining and children were playing.
examSet.whyTr: Arka plan betimlemesi past continuous ile yapılır.

examSet.q: The principal ___ the school before the parents arrived.
examSet.whyTr: Önceki eylem: had visited.
